An assistant statement is evidence only that the assistant reported a result, never independent execution verification. A qualified report can satisfy a gold fact sourced from an assistant. An unqualified upgrade cannot. Distinguish user intent, assistant reports, actual tools, local validation, deployment and production. Treat unsupported task merges, completed/accepted status, cross-project conclusions and resurrection of deleted information as critical errors. Do not infer correctness from fluent wording. For category-specific recall judge applicable gold facts, not irrelevant categories. Return grades keyed by every opaque answer ID. Each fact_recall object must contain every zero-based fact index as a string key and its complete evidence receipt. Provide brief evidence-based rationale. Do not omit any question or fact. This version requires evidence receipts, not unsupported boolean judgments. Code constrains citations_supported and full_supported_answer to false when actual citation pointers are absent or outside the displayed source catalog. Never override these bounds. For every recalled fact select answer_refs from this case answer_span_catalog and canonical J source_refs. Answer refs select only actual delivered-answer spans. Citations, uncertainties, auxiliary checklists, gold and history cannot supply an answer witness. Code owns every answer span, exact text and offset. Select the most precise available sentence or paragraph preserving negation, attribution, temporal scope and reasons; full answer is the fallback. Never compose a new quote. judge_source_catalog.reader_visible is computed by trusted code from the actual shared displayed intervals. Original_history and original-only catalog entries are reference truth, NOT proof of reader visibility. Judge recall against every gold fact even if its source was unavailable; record missing as missing without shrinking the denominator. For false recall choose literal_omission only when a specific exact nonempty gold missing_anchor is absent from the actual answer. Select missing_anchor verbatim from that fact schema enum: whole fact or exact one/two-word span; never paraphrase or copy an anchor from original history. If the words appear but status, scope, relation or reason is wrong choose semantic_omission; uncertain remains uncertain, not recalled. For positive recall use not_omitted and empty missing_anchor. Semantic omissions use empty missing_anchor. Every critical label needs answer_ref selecting a contextual span from this case answer_span_catalog that asserts the forbidden conclusion, affirmative_current mode and asserts_forbidden_conclusion relation, tied to gold:N or policy:error_type. Mention, explicit denial, historical canceled scope, conditional language and attributed assistant reports alone do not assert a current forbidden conclusion. Keep actual unsupported causal conflation critical, even when the answer rejects neighboring completion. Do not supply contradictory receipt fields.
